title: Every night, check OPay for terminal payments the notifications missed
summary: Late every night, ask OPay for each terminal's successful payments of the day and add any that are not in the POS sales table yet.
description: Every night at the time you choose, for each terminal in your terminals table, asks OPay for the day's successful payments on that terminal and adds them to your POS sales table. A payment already recorded from a notification is recognised by its reference, so nothing is counted twice, and a notification that never arrived is made good before the day closes. Fill in your terminals table with each terminal's serial number first.
